description.value: McCulloch Station Pub is Kelowna's original neighbourhood pub, opened in 1985 in East Kelowna and named in honour of Andrew McCulloch, the engineer who built the Kettle Valley Railway — the very rail corridor that touring cyclists now ride as the KVR trail. Situated near historic East Kelowna landmarks, the family-owned pub features a celebrated patio, a full food menu, an on-tap draught selection, and an attached liquor store. It is an adult-only (19+) establishment.

address.value: 2789 K.L.O. Road, Kelowna, British Columbia, V1W 4A5
